codeReview.summary: Current repo state still does not satisfy runtime rail-isolation and stable-to-dev refresh robustness requirements. The two prior blocking issues remain unchanged from commit 59a820f29 through HEAD.

issues.description: Rail image isolation is still incomplete. The script defaults `LOCAL_CODE_SANDBOX_PYTHON_IMAGE` to a shared tag (`librechat-local-sandbox-python:latest`) and rebuilds it on start when unchanged. Because both rails also default to this same tag in compose (`docker-compose.local.override.yml:189`), dev rebuild/start can mutate the sandbox artifact used by stable, violating expected rail isolation by image tags.

Stable-to-dev Mongo refresh still shells unescaped credentials into the remote command (`-u $MUSER -p $MPASS`). Passwords with shell metacharacters or spaces are valid and can break or alter command parsing, so the sync path is not robust for VAL-RUNTIME-008 behavior.

When dev is initially stopped, the script starts MongoDB 'temporarily for restore' but has no corresponding stop path afterward unless the stack was already running. This can leave an unexpected partially running dev state.
